threat_event: Ransomware launched from the office network spreads through the dual-homed MES server and the flat plant network, encrypting HMIs, test PCs, and the MES and stopping production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat plant network; any-any rule from engineering network; dual-homed MES; unsupported HMIs; EDR alerts unmonitored after hours
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05; SYS-06; SYS-07; BP-01 to BP-05
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-046, G-058); C-CRITICAL-MFG-R01 (proposed 226.2(b)(3)(iii); readiness)
existing_controls: EDR on office endpoints; edge firewall; MFA on IT access
treatment_plan: Remove MES dual-homing and put MES and historian in an OT DMZ; deny-by-default IT/OT rules; 24x7 managed detection; offline OT program backups; P08 runbook and tabletop

threat_event: Ransomware operator with stolen cloud administrator rights encrypts the ERP and APS virtual machines and deletes backups kept in the same account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ERP backups in the same account and region; not immutable; never restore-tested
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-03; BP-01; BP-06 to BP-08
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-041, G-059); C-CRITICAL-MFG-R03 (762.6 records in the ERP)
existing_controls: MFA and hardware keys for cloud administrators; daily database backups
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention and a second region; break-glass accounts; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: Attacker uses an always-on OEM cellular router to reach the vapor-phase drying oven controls and changes temperature or vacuum setpoints
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OEM routers always on with shared passwords, no MFA, no logging; oven HMI reachable from the plant network
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-034, G-051)
existing_controls: Hardwired over-temperature and pressure safety interlocks independent of the PLC
treatment_plan: Disable OEM routers except during approved sessions now; replace with one remote access gateway with MFA, per-session approval, and recording

threat_event: Business email compromise of a buyer's mailbox leads to a fraudulent change of a supplier's bank details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing exercises; supplier bank changes verified by email only
existing_controls: MFA on email; EDR
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for bank changes; quarterly phishing exercises; mailbox rule alerts

threat_event: TMU firmware image on the engineering share is replaced with a tampered version and loaded into transformers shipped to utility substations
threat_source: Advanced threat actor targeting the grid supply chain
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No signature or hash check on receipt or at final test; engineering share writable by all engineers
regulatory_driver: Utility addendum sec. 5 (CIP-013-2 R1.2.5 flow-down; P03 G-086); CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-029)
existing_controls: Supplier portal requires login; firmware versions recorded on test reports
treatment_plan: Verify supplier signatures or hashes on receipt and before loading; restrict the library to 3 engineers; publish hashes to utilities

threat_event: Company misses a utility addendum duty (48-hour incident notice, 30-day vulnerability disclosure, or access notice) and a utility suspends or ends its supply agreement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Addenda signed but not tracked; no owners, contacts, or procedures; 2 advisories already undisclosed
regulatory_driver: Utility addendum secs. 1, 3, 4 (CIP-013-2 R1.2.1, R1.2.3, R1.2.4 flow-down; P03 G-082, G-084, G-085)
existing_controls: Contracts filed in the contract system
treatment_plan: Obligations register; disclose the 2 open advisories; notice procedures in P08; access notice in the HR checklist

threat_event: A former field technician uses a retained utility site badge or remote access credential
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Departures not reported to utilities (2 of 3 in 2026)
regulatory_driver: Utility addendum sec. 3 (CIP-013-2 R1.2.3 flow-down; P03 G-084)
existing_controls: Utilities issue their own credentials and expire some badges
treatment_plan: Report all 3 departures now; HR checklist step with a 1-business-day notice

threat_event: Use of covered video surveillance equipment and an inaccurate SAM representation lead the agency to withhold award or extension of federal work
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 legacy yard cameras from a covered manufacturer; no covered-equipment check in purchasing
existing_controls: Cameras reported to the contracting officer 2026-07-21; follow-up sent 2026-08-03
treatment_plan: Disconnect now; replace by 2026-10-31; correct the representation with counsel; purchasing check

threat_event: Attacker exploits a known vulnerability in an unsupported HMI operating system to disrupt a coil winding line
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 11 unsupported HMI and engineering workstations; no OT patching; flat network
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-023, G-043)
existing_controls: Plant network not reachable from the internet except through OEM routers
treatment_plan: Zone the winding lines; replace or isolate unsupported HMIs with OEM support

threat_event: Malware on an OEM technician's USB drive infects an HMI during a service visit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HMIs accept USB drives; no media scanning; service visits not supervised
existing_controls: Technicians escorted on site
treatment_plan: Scanning kiosk for removable media; USB control on HMIs; escort checklist

threat_event: Test data for a power transformer is lost or corrupted on a test PC with a shared administrator account and no backup, forcing a retest or a delayed shipment
threat_source: Test PC failure or operator error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared admin account; local-only storage until the MES upload; no backups of test PCs
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-033, G-041)
existing_controls: Quality reviews and signs each test report; test data uploaded to MES after each test
treatment_plan: Unique test PC accounts; automatic copy of raw test files to the MES server; weekly image backups

threat_event: Departing engineer copies transformer designs and winding specifications from open shares and the PLM vault
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Design shares open to all office users; no data loss monitoring
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-022, G-039)
existing_controls: NDAs and invention agreements; PLM login required
treatment_plan: Restrict design shares to named groups; alert on bulk PLM exports; exit interview reminders

threat_event: Engineers paste design calculations or federal contract information into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No AI policy or approved-tools list; no web filtering for AI sites
existing_controls: NDA reminders in engineering
treatment_plan: POL-05 approved-tools list; block unapproved AI sites; enterprise AI tool with no-training terms (P10)

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote monitoring and management tool pushes malicious code to every IT server and endpoint
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RMM has administrator rights everywhere; MSP activity not reviewed
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-016, G-051)
existing_controls: MSP SOC 2 Type 2 (Security); MFA on the MSP tool per the report
treatment_plan: Restrict RMM to IT servers and endpoints only (never OT); monthly MSP activity report; contract incident notice within 24 hours

threat_event: Identity provider administrator account taken over through MFA fatigue or token theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 administrators with standing access
existing_controls: Hardware security keys for all 3 administrators; sign-in risk policies
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Manager: residual risk Low

threat_event: ERP super user changes vendor master data or pricing to commit fraud
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 ERP super users; no review of master data changes
existing_controls: Dual approval for payments over $25,000
treatment_plan: Reduce super users to 2; monthly master data change report

threat_event: Terminated production worker's MES account is used to post false labor or material confirmations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MES and kiosk accounts disabled up to 7 days after termination
existing_controls: Supervisors review labor postings daily
treatment_plan: Same-day disable from the HR ticket for MES accounts

threat_event: A hurricane closes the plant for several days during storm-restoration demand
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single plant; no documented contingency plan
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-047, G-048)
existing_controls: Generators for server rooms and test bay; hurricane checklist; cloud-hosted ERP
treatment_plan: Contingency plan with remote ERP operations, storm-order priorities, and supplier coordination

threat_event: Loss of the campus internet link or VPN to the cloud tenant stops ERP access and MES work order release
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single internet provider; MES depends on the integration service in the cloud
existing_controls: MES holds released work orders for about 2 shifts
treatment_plan: Second carrier with automatic failover; printed 5-day schedule refreshed daily

threat_event: Cloud provider regional outage makes the ERP and APS unavailable for more than a day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ERP in one region; no tested cross-region restore
existing_controls: Provider availability commitments
treatment_plan: Backup copies in a second region; documented restore to that region (tested annually)

threat_event: A failed PLC or CNC controller cannot be restored because its program and the winding recipes were never backed up
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Programs copied ad hoc to one laptop (last copy 2026-02)
existing_controls: OEMs hold some original programs
treatment_plan: Monthly program and recipe backups to an offline store; version check against controllers

threat_event: An untested PLC program change on a winding machine produces coils with the wrong turn count that reach final test or a customer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT change control or program versioning
existing_controls: Turns-ratio test at final test catches most errors
treatment_plan: OT change procedure with Plant Manager approval and program version records

threat_event: Attacker abuses the AI-002 historian connector's outbound internet path to reach the plant network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor connector installed on the historian with outbound internet; not reviewed
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-030, G-046)
existing_controls: Connector initiates outbound TLS only
treatment_plan: Move the connector to the OT DMZ with a one-way replica of historian data; vendor security review

threat_event: AI-001 demand forecast under-predicts orders from municipal and cooperative utilities, so they receive fewer production slots and longer storm-season lead times
threat_source: AI model error and data sparsity
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No accuracy monitoring by customer segment; forecast drives slot proposals
existing_controls: Production Planning Manager approves the monthly plan
treatment_plan: Segment error monitoring; human allocation rules for storm orders (P10)

threat_event: AI-002 fails to flag a failing vacuum pump on the drying oven, causing an unplanned outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot model trained on 18 months of data
existing_controls: Time-based preventive maintenance continues unchanged during the pilot
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Manager: residual risk Low while preventive maintenance stays in place

threat_event: State-sponsored actor quietly steals power transformer designs and customer substation drawings over several months
threat_source: Nation-state actor targeting the grid supply chain
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No monitoring; design data on open shares; no threat intelligence
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-049, G-025)
existing_controls: EDR on engineering workstations
treatment_plan: 24x7 managed detection; restricted design shares; CISA advisories

threat_event: Known vulnerabilities in OT devices go unnoticed because no one tracks advisories against an inventory
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT inventory or advisory subscription
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-018, G-024, G-025)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: OT inventory; weekly advisory review; annual passive OT vulnerability assessment

threat_event: Federal contract information on open shares or in email is exposed to unauthorized staff or outsiders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: FCI not identified; project folder open to all office users
existing_controls: MFA on email; identity provider
treatment_plan: Restrict FCI folders; label FCI; brief the project team

threat_event: Unencrypted PLM or file server disks are removed or disposed of with design data readable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: On-premises server disks unencrypted; no destruction certificates
existing_controls: Locked server room with badge access
treatment_plan: Volume encryption; certified destruction vendor

threat_event: Employee personal information on the file server is taken in an incident and the 30-day Florida notice is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR exports on the file server; no breach assessment procedure
existing_controls: Payroll system is SaaS
treatment_plan: Move HR exports to the HR SaaS; notification matrix with the Fla. Stat. 501.171 clocks (P08)

threat_event: CIRCIA is finalized as proposed and the company cannot report a covered incident to CISA within 72 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident declaration criteria or reporting procedure
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Declaration criteria and a CISA reporting step in P08 now (voluntary until a final rule is effective)

threat_event: Saved utility remote access password on a shared field laptop is used by the wrong person
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared field laptops; saved credentials
regulatory_driver: Utility addendum sec. 6 (CIP-013-2 R1.2.6 flow-down; P03 G-087)
existing_controls: Utility systems require MFA at connection
treatment_plan: Named laptops; password manager; no saved credentials

threat_event: EDI provider outage delays purchase orders and advance ship notices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single EDI provider
existing_controls: Customer portals and email as fallback
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Manager: residual risk Low

threat_event: Anyone on the plant network logs in to the drying oven HMI web configuration page with the OEM default password and changes recipes or alarms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OEM default password on the oven HMI web interface (found in P07 testing); flat plant network
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-033); P07 finding IA-05e.
existing_controls: Hardwired safety interlocks
treatment_plan: Change the password now; disable the web interface where the OEM allows; zone the ovens
